THE COMPOSITION

Sky = the instruction. Ground = your controls. The horizon between them is the progress indicator — it lights left to right, once, slowly, in one direction. No ring, no number ticking down, no pulse.

On the visual reset that matters twice over: the whole instruction is to look AWAY from the screen, so the screen must not hold a figure that changes every second. Round 1 proved that by drawing it. This fixes it.

TWO ATMOSPHERES, ONE LANDSCAPE

Visual reset is far: deep dusk, low distant sun, vast sky.
Movement is near: an hour later, sun close and low, coral and rose, more energy.

Half-second recognition without reading a word — the goal round 1 chased with band heights, achieved with colour temperature instead. Cheaper, prettier, and it can't collide with the text.

STILL OWED

· Increase Contrast and Reduce Transparency fallbacks for every glass surface — if legibility depends on the blur, it is broken.
· Light appearance for the menu and Settings.
· Contrast audit of white-on-field type at the brightest point of each gradient.
· The 12-criterion score for this direction.
· Real renders in place of the CSS skies.
